annotation.title_clean: Model Artificial Intelligence Governance Framework, Second Edition
annotation.title_en: Model Artificial Intelligence Governance Framework, Second Edition
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Info-communications Media Development Authority (IMDA) and Personal Data Protection Commission (PDPC), Singapore
annotation.summary_en: Singapore's voluntary, sector-agnostic Model AI Governance Framework (2nd edition, Jan 2020) by IMDA and PDPC. It translates AI ethics principles into practical guidance on internal governance, level of human involvement in decisions, operations management and stakeholder communication, with industry examples. Contains no robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Voluntary, algorithm-, technology- and sector-agnostic baseline for organisations deploying AI
Four areas: internal governance, human involvement in decisions, operations management, stakeholder communication
Human-in-the-loop, human-over-the-loop and human-out-of-the-loop models chosen by risk and harm severity
Data accountability, robustness, reproducibility and auditability measures
Algorithm audits only on regulator request in forensic investigations
